note: D4 slot 1 is upgrade_or_affinity: the tidewarden kit holds three upgradable bases, but mycelium_dash is pure mobility and deepens no build, so the slot candidates are the parity picks of the two that do - [water_jet+pin, seed_bomb+tangle] on this even floor (d4_upgrade_filter.json pins that filter) - and it reports upgrade. water_jet+pin here, picked, which replaces the base in place (draft_upgrade, not a kit slot spent). Slot 2, wild, deals water_jet+sluice: the sibling the upgrade slot could not offer this floor is still in the universe, and the shrine forge sells it outright, so no D6 fork is unobtainable. The role falls back to the affinity list only when no held base has a build-defining variant left, and under the upgrades_only mutator every slot collapses to the whole upgrade list (c4_upgrades_only). Offer 0 is the affinity slot on the same seed and board as d4_affinity_slot: the set is {water, displace, growth} here, so it deals vine_whip (displace) where the flarekeeper gets moss_filter (sun). Pre-D4 this seed dealt bramble_coat, sun_flare, thorn_shield to the tidewarden - and the identical three ids to the default tender kit, because the old roll could not tell the two runs apart
